messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is prescribed to manage polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
Metformin improves how the body responds to insulin.
PCOS affects about 1 in 10 women of reproductive age.
PCOS is often marked by insulin resistance.
In insulin resistance, the body doesn't respond well to insulin.
This lack of response prompts the pancreas to produce more insulin.
This excess insulin drives up androgen production.
Androgen is a male hormone.
This process worsens symptoms like irregular periods, infertility, acne, and excess hair growth.
Metformin helps by lowering insulin levels.
Metformin helps by decreasing the liver's glucose production.
Metformin helps by improving glucose uptake by muscles.
Metformin helps by reducing circulating androgen levels.
Reducing circulating androgen levels can support more regular ovulation.
Reducing circulating androgen levels can support more regular menstrual cycles.
Metformin is not FDA-approved to treat PCOS.
Metformin is widely prescribed as an off-label treatment.
Metformin is prescribed particularly for those with insulin resistance.
Triplet: ["increased insulin production", "leads to", "increased androgen production"]

The relation 'leads to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or process results in or contributes to the specified effect or outcome.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'occurs as': The subject condition or event happens as a result of or is associated with the process specified by the object entity.
C. 'is first sign of': The subject condition or effect may be the initial indication of the object condition or effect.
D. 'may affect': The subject drug may influence or alter the physiological process or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'involves': The subject condition or process includes or is characterized by the entity specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
